articles.title: Regions Financial Announces David Turner to Retire, Anil Chadha to Serve as Chief Financial Officer
articles.mainIdea: Regions Financial Announces David Turner to Retire, Anil Chadha to Serve as Chief Financial Officer
articles.summary: Business Wire: Regions Financial Announces David Turner to Retire, Anil Chadha to Serve as Chief Financial Officer. BIRMINGHAM, Ala., January 12, 2026--Regions Financial Corp. announced Chief Financial Officer David Turner will retire on March 31. He will be succeeded as CFO by Anil Chadha of Regions. Related tickers mentioned: RF-PE, RF-PF.
